• Dogecoin (DOGE): $0.002 → $0.73 (6,000% gain)
• Ethereum (ETH): $130 → $4,891 (3,660% gain)

The alt season ended on Nov 10, 2021, after Bitcoin hit a new ATH of $69,000, marking the start of another 2-year bear market
